templates.goal: Reduce the complete mapped sha256_core cell area by optimizing only the sha256_w_mem module.

criteria.statement: The complete mapped sha256_core area is at most 64209.869856 um2, at least 1% below the unchanged input baseline of 64858.4544 um2, using the fixed Yosys flow and library specified in inputs/yosys.md.

Only sha256_w_mem may change. The sha256_core and sha256_k_constants module bytes remain identical to inputs/sha256.v. Public ports, active-low asynchronous reset, init/next behavior including simultaneous controls, and every observable cycle of SHA224 and SHA256 remain equivalent to inputs/sha256.v.
